title: Design Notes

purpose.en: A look back at why each module was designed the way it is: plans, phases and decisions written during the build. Read-only, kept for the owner.
purpose.id: Kilas balik mengapa tiap modul dirancang demikian: rencana, fase, dan keputusan yang ditulis saat pembangunan. Hanya baca, disimpan untuk pemilik.

keywords: design notes, catatan perancangan, rencana teknis, keputusan, kilas balik, technical plan, riwayat desain

steps.en: Open Design Notes. Each card is one note with its area (Maintenance, Inventory, PPIC) and a short summary.
steps.id: Buka Design Notes. Tiap kartu satu catatan dengan areanya (Maintenance, Inventory, PPIC) dan ringkasan singkat.

steps.en: Search inside the notes, or use the boxes on top to narrow by area.
steps.id: Cari di dalam catatan, atau pakai kotak di atas untuk menyaring menurut area.

steps.en: Click Read article to read the whole note. For how a screen works today, use Guides instead.
steps.id: Klik Read article untuk membaca seluruh catatan. Untuk cara kerja layar saat ini, pakai Guides.
